decisions.decision: pi's own contract (types.ts AssistantMessageEvent) makes partial the shared live response-so-far, not an event-time snapshot. Both sides serialize it when the consumer receives the event; pi's single-threaded runner happens to reach every event before producing the next, while barness's producer runs concurrently with the consumer without backpressure (spec I8/I9), so its view may already hold later deltas, blocks and block ends (including their signatures). Event-own fields (contentIndex, delta, end content), the terminal message and the Result are compared strictly; the live-view contract (one shared view, never behind the event being read, synchronized snapshots, settles on the final message) is asserted by the E01 offline E2E TestStreamLifecycle. A partial missing on barness or differing in identity fields stays pending.
decisions.ref: spec I8 累计部分响应; issues/04; ai/e2e/stream_lifecycle_test.go

decisions.decision: pi's own contract (types.ts AssistantMessageEvent) makes partial the shared live response-so-far, not an event-time snapshot; the same decision as openai-responses events[*].partial. Both sides serialize it when the consumer receives the event; pi's single-threaded runner reaches every event before producing the next, while barness's producer runs concurrently with the consumer without backpressure (spec I8/I9), so its view may already hold later deltas, blocks, block ends, signature deltas, usage from message_start/message_delta, the response id and model, and the stop reason. Event-own fields (contentIndex, delta, end content), the terminal message and the Result are compared strictly; the live-view contract is asserted by the E01 offline E2E TestStreamLifecycle. A partial missing on barness or differing in identity fields stays pending.
decisions.ref: spec I8 累计部分响应; issues/04; issues/16; ai/e2e/stream_lifecycle_test.go

decisions.decision: pi's Anthropic stream opens a thinking block with thinkingSignature "" (content_block.signature ?? "") and grows it through signature_delta; barness's Thinking.Signature omits the empty string (the field is shared with Responses, where pi writes no signature until the block ends). Both mean unsigned and replay identically (pi's convertMessages treats a blank signature as missing). Only the live partial is excused: a final message whose signature differs stays pending, so a lost signature cannot hide here.

StopReason aborted and the content received before the abort match. Asserted by TestAnthropicFailures (canceled-mid-stream, deadline-mid-stream).

decisions.decision: Spec-defined extension (spec I6, ADR-0001: native state is replayed only under a trusted envelope; without one it is downgraded by the cross-model rules and the call goes ahead). pi has no envelope and replays same-model signed and redacted thinking from any history; barness replays it only when the host vouched for the message (TrustNativeState) or barness produced it in-process. Restored without that, the blank signed thinking and the redacted block are dropped and the turn keeps its text, and Result metadata counts one noEnvelope downgrade (barness-only, not part of the pi message). The trusted replay of the same history matches pi exactly (PIDIFF-P02-signed-empty-and-redacted-stream). Asserted by the offline E2E TestAnthropicHistory.
decisions.ref: spec I6; ADR-0001; issues/07; issues/16; ai/e2e/anthropic_history_test.go
